title: Texture avenues in a showcase room
question: Which of these effects do you want in the game? Pick one or more, or none.

options.label: 2. Procedural materials
options.note: Tiles each a slightly different shade, some with a chipped corner; carpet tiles with the pile laid in alternating directions; faint grain on the desk; streaks on the metal; cloudy plaster. Easy to see close up, faint at the game camera. About the same draws as today.

options.label: 3. Decals and wear
options.note: Shoe marks and scuffs by the door, a worn path across the carpet to the chair, caster marks, a coffee ring, tape marks where a poster was, stickers on the cabinet, a taped cable on the floor. The one that shows most at the game camera. The worn path reads a bit like a patch of light. +2 draws.

options.label: 4. Vertex colour and baked light
options.note: Darker under the desk and chair, at wall bottoms and in the corners; the floor shades from the window side to the front; binders and chairs vary a little in tint. No pattern. Same draws, 40% more triangles (big faces split up), about 0.2 s more to build the room.

options.label: 7. Trim sheets
options.note: Keys on the keyboard, vents on the PC and monitor back, labels on the binder spines, panel lines and screws on the drawers, a scuffed top on the skirting. Mostly too small to see at the game camera. Same draws.

options.label: 8. Small modelled detail
options.note: Window with mullions and a sill (its shadow falls on the floor), door frame and hinges, drawer handles, a real keyboard, mouse, mug with a rim, paper pile, cables to a wall socket, chair on a five-star base, paper in the bin. Reads at the game camera. About 100 more draws here (new colours); the game's batching pass would merge most of them.

links.label: Open the showcase room (keys 0 2 3 4 7 8 switch looks, V changes the view)
What each avenue is meant to be

decision: 2 as a toggle (Settings > Graphics > Surface detail) on all models, props included; 4 in a softer version; 8 as in the showcase. In the game: review style-in-game.
